avoid_supplements.name: Chromium (high-dose >200mcg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chromium enhances insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake, potentiating hypoglycemic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose chromium supplementation; monitor blood glucose closely if used at standard doses

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (American/Asian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Ginseng reduces blood glucose levels and may increase insulin sensitivity, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, require frequent glucose monitoring and dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Bitter Melon
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains compounds that mimic insulin action and enhance glucose utilization, additive hypoglycemic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid this supplement entirely

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity and reduce blood glucose; potential for minor hypoglycemia risk
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor blood glucose and adjust insulin dose if needed

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have modest glucose-lowering properties; clinical significance is minor
caution_supplements.action: Monitor glucose; unlikely to require dose adjustment but track trends

caution_supplements.name: Fenugreek
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce postprandial glucose; mechanism unclear but appears modest
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; inform healthcare provider of use

avoid_foods.name: Refined/simple carbohydrates (high glycemic index foods)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption causes acute hyperglycemia, requiring dose titration; degludec's long half-life may not accommodate rapid changes
avoid_foods.action: Educate patient on carbohydrate counting and consistent carbohydrate intake; counsel on low-to-moderate glycemic index foods

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol impairs hepatic glucose production and increases hypoglycemia risk; degludec's long-acting nature prolongs this effect
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol to moderate amounts with food; educate on hypoglycemia symptoms and glucagon availability

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat delays gastric emptying, potentially affecting postprandial glucose patterns; may require timing adjustments
caution_foods.action: Counsel on balanced meals; monitor glucose response to high-fat meals

monitoring_notes: Insulin degludec requires individualized glucose monitoring and dose adjustments based on patient-specific factors including diet, activity, and concurrent medications. Counsel patients on consistent carbohydrate intake, recognition of hypoglycemic symptoms, and the importance of regular blood glucose monitoring to maintain glycemic control.
